description: Inputs for Video To Video inference
title: VideoToVideoInput

inputs.description: The input video data as a base64-encoded string. If no `parameters` are provided, you can also provide the video data as a raw bytes payload.

parameters.description: Additional inference parameters for Video To Video

prompt.description: The text prompt to guide the video generation.

negative_prompt.description: One prompt to guide what NOT to include in video generation.

guidance_scale.description: For diffusion models. A higher guidance scale value encourages the model to generate videos closely linked to the text prompt at the expense of lower video quality.

num_inference_steps.description: The number of denoising steps. More denoising steps usually lead to a higher quality video at the expense of slower inference.

num_frames.description: The num_frames parameter determines how many video frames are generated.

target_size.description: The size in pixel of the output video frames.

seed.description: Seed for the random number generator.
